instruction:
Task: Navigate between different customization sections (e.g., 'Appearance', 'Behavior', 'Data') by clicking their respective tabs in the customization panel.
Expected Result: The set of available customization controls within the panel updates to display options relevant to the newly selected section.

Note: The task is only considered successful if the expected result is achieved; otherwise, it is deemed infeasible.
expected: The set of available customization controls within the panel updates to display options relevant to the newly selected section.
